name: Shotacon Ryoubo-san ni Kawaigarareru Subarashiki Hibi
original_name: ショタコン寮母さんに可愛がられる素晴らしき日々
source:
She was the most tender lady.
If you showed her your test score she'd curl her fingers in your hair, and she never got angry if you messed the bedsheets.
Her pretty mouth was always in the shape of a warm smile.
That's why everyone wanted to live in this dorm. She was mother to us all.
That's what I thought.

Until the night she brought that pretty mouth into my room one night and sucked my d*ck.

That night, she wasn't anything like my mother.

She was a craven whore with a fetish for young boys.
A hot throat that loved the delicious taste of little boy c*ck.
Only a shonen like me got her panties wet.

Follow the story as protagonist Youta, who becomes the special sexual prey of the "dorm mother" at boarding school.
